rules: No payment, subscription, purchase, credit, paid API, paid hosting, or auto-renewal.
No service may be marked connected unless connection or execution is verified.
A tool can be recorded as candidate without being installed or connected.
If free quota/resource limits are reached, pause and report; do not incur charges.

Any money-related action requires explicit owner approval bound to the exact action; the current hard-zero policy still blocks payment, transfer, withdrawal, purchase, subscription, and other spending in this runtime.
